593930425.detail_text: SUPER ALOE VERA COLLECTION Novex Super Aloe Vera Collection is specially designed to intensely repair and hydrate damage hair. It nourishes and strengthen the hair fiber promoting healthy hair growth and softness, also fighting against excessive hair loss and dandruff. It will leave your hair with a glossy shine and 100% repaired from damage caused by constant use of hair color, heat tools and salt water. Novex Super Aloe Vera entire collection contains Hydrovance, an active agent that acts on the hair fiber from the cuticle to the medulla, providing hydration, repair, strengthening, sensory improvement, frizz & volume control, natural appearance, and softness. BENEFITS OF SUPER ALOE VERA COLLECTION! SUPER HYDRATION Aloe Vera is high in water content and acts as a humectant which gives you healthy looking hair. It not only provides hydration to the dry scalps but also locks in the moisture, leaving your hair soft and luscious, thus improving the overall health of your hair. SUPER CLEANSER Anti-pruritic properties and proteolytic enzymes in aloe vera cleanses scalp and removes dead skin cells which are the prime cause of flakiness and dandruff in your hair. It is also known to be a natural cleanser which clears dirt, product build-up and excess sebum off of the scalps. As a result, it cures the scalp itching and dandruff and gives you a cleaner, healthier scalp. SUPER HEALANT Aloe vera has antifungal, antibacterial and healing properties. It relieves itchiness and irritation while also healing any fungal infections in the scalp. It is effective against fungus and yeast birthing in the scalps that causes dandruff, infections and other hair issues like hair loss. SUPER GROWTH Aloe vera boosts the growth of dormant follicles and thus helps in faster regrowth of hair. Power packed with proteolytic enzyme and minerals such as copper and zinc which help stimulate hair growth. SUPER HYDROVANCE A n active agent that acts on the hair fiber from the cuticle to the medulla, providing hydration, repair, strengthening, sensory improvement, frizz & volume control, natural appearance, and softness. NOVEX SALT FREE SUPER ALOE VERA HAIR MASK 1KG Novex Super Aloe Vera Hair Mask Babosa has an active moisturizing action. It is infused with the purest aloe vera straight from Brazil. It also contains hydromancy, an agent that acts on the hair fiber from the cuticle to the medulla, providing hydration, repair, strengthening, sensory improvement, frizz & volume control, natural appearance, and softness. INGREDIENTS Aqua (water), Cetearyl Alcohol, Zea Mays Starch, Butyrospermum Parkii Butter, Glycine Soy Oil, Cetrimonium Chloride, Benzyl Alcohol, Parfum, Alcohol, Hydroxyethyl Urea, Benzoic Acid, Bht, Ceteareth-60 Myristyl Glycol, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract, Hexyl Cinnamal, Sorbic Acid, Linalool, Butylphenyl Methylproponal, Sorbitol, D-Limonene, Tocopheryl Acetate, Lactic Acid, Potassium Sorbate, Sodium Benzoate.

13702357558.detail_html:
Olaplex No. 0 Intensive Bond Building Hair Treatment







Scientifically Proven: 68% more repair & 3x stronger hair* *When used as a two-part system in just one use.



APPLICATION TIP: N°.0 bottle should last 3-6 applications, based on hair length and density.





How To Use:



1. Apply N°.0 slowly to dry hair, distributing evenly from root to tip.



2. Work N°.0 into small sections by squeezing the liquid into the hair to be fully absorbed as you go



3. Lightly saturate. Hair should be damp, not drench. Let process for 10 minutes. DO NOT RINSE.



4. Apply N°.3 over hair with N°.0 still applied. Comb through and process for at least another 10 minutes.



5. Rinse, shampoo & condition. For best results, use N°.4 Shampoo & N°.5 conditioner.





When: Use the two-part system with N°.3 once a week or two to three times a week for damaged hair.





Where: Apply to dry hair, fully saturating each section.





For: All hair types, especially for those with visible damage.





Ingredients: Water (Aqua/Eau), Bis-Aminopropyl Diglycol Dimaleate, Phenoxyethanol, Sodium Benzoate





Free of DEA, Aldehydes, and Formaldehyde



-----------------



N°.7 dramatically increases shine, softness, and color vibrancy while minimizing flyaways and frizz.





Key benefits:



• Repairs damaged and compromised hair



• Strengthens and protects hair structure



• Restores healthy appearance and texture





How To:



1. Remove cap. Turn the bottle upside down and gently tap to dispense a metered drop.



2. Apply a small amount to damp or dry hair, style as desired.



3. Re-apply lightly before re-styling of dry hair, between washes.





Where: Just a few drops restores hair appearance and texture.





When: Can be used daily on wet and dry hair, or before styling with heat.





For: All hair types, especially for those using heat tools daily.





Ingredients: Dimethicone, Isohexadecane, C13-14 Isoparaffin, Coco-Caprylate, Phenyl Trimethicone, Bis-Aminopropyl Diglycol Dimaleate, Propanediol, Zea Mays (Corn) Oil, Beta-Carotene, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Moringa Oleifera Seed Oil, Punica Granatum Seed Oil, Water (Aqua/Eau), Morinda Citrifolia Fruit Powder, Fragrance (Parfum), Hexyl Cinnamal, Eclipta Prostrata Extract, Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate, Limonene, Tocopherol, Citral, Linalool, Melia Azadirachta Leaf Extract, Citronellol, Pseudozyma Epicola/Camellia Sinensis Seed Oil Ferment Extract Filtrate.





Free of DEA, Aldehydes and Formaldehyde.

product.desc:
FINO Premium Touch Hair Essence Mask

✨ **FINO Premium Touch Hair Essence Mask | Shiseido Salon-Grade Hair Repair Miracle**

The legendary Japanese hair mask from Shiseido, loved by beauty enthusiasts and hair care experts alike! Specially formulated to solve all common hair problems, it’s the must-have hair care essential for every Singaporean looking for salon-quality results at home.

✅ **6 Powerhouse Beauty Ingredients for Deep Nourishment**

Infused with 6 high-quality skincare-grade ingredients, including hydrolyzed collagen, hyaluronic acid, and royal jelly extract, this hair mask deeply penetrates the hair core, effectively repairing damaged hair cuticles, replenishing lost moisture, and reversing dryness, dullness, frizz, knots, and split ends. It strengthens hair from the inside out, leaving your locks silky, bouncy, and full of natural shine💫

✅ **Luxurious Jelly Texture & Non-Greasy Formula**

The rich, translucent jelly texture glides on smoothly and absorbs quickly, without weighing hair down or leaving any sticky residue. Unlike ordinary hair masks, it won’t make your hair look flat or greasy—perfect for all hair types, especially color-treated, perm-damaged, or over-styled hair. Enjoy salon-level repair in the comfort of your own bathroom, saving time and money!

✅ **Elegant Floral Fragrance for a Relaxing SPA Experience**

Crafted with a delicate and long-lasting floral scent: bright citrus and pear top notes open with a fresh, lively vibe, followed by soft rose and jasmine middle notes, and finished with warm cashmere musk base notes. Every time you use it, your hair will be wrapped in a gentle, pleasant fragrance that lingers all day, turning your daily hair care routine into a relaxing SPA moment

✅ **Proven Effective with Lab-Tested Results**

Backed by professional lab tests: after just one use, hair moisture is boosted by +401%, frizz resistance is increased by +16%, and damaged hair is instantly transformed into a smooth, glossy, and manageable state. With long-term use, it can significantly improve hair toughness, reduce breakage, and keep your hair healthy and strong even in Singapore’s humid weather.

✅ **230g Large Capacity & Great Value for Money**

The 230g large tub is designed to last for months, offering high cost-performance for daily hair care. It’s perfectly suited for busy Singaporean lifestyles—whether you’re a working professional, a busy mom, or a student, you can easily incorporate it into your weekly hair care routine without any hassle. Suitable for all hair types, from dry and frizzy to thin and fragile.

💡 **Professional Usage Tips**

After shampooing, gently towel-dry your hair until it’s damp. Apply an appropriate amount of the mask from mid-length to the ends (avoiding the scalp), massage gently to ensure even coverage, leave it on for 5-10 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with warm water. For best results, use 1-2 times a week. Pair it with FINO hair shampoo for a complete hair care routine and achieve even better repair effects!

3182377101.title: Coffee & Ginseng Fortifying Hair Treatment - 100ml / 3.4 fl.oz. (Exp 06/2026)
3182377101.detail_text: Coffee & Ginseng Fortifying Hair Treatment Give dry, brittle, or frizzy hair a much-needed moisture boost with this fortifying pre-shower hair treatment. Nutrient-rich botanical oils provide deep hydration and enhance hair’s natural shine. Coffee and ginseng are known for their stimulating and strengthening properties. The result is hair that is smoother, stronger and more lustrous. Key Ingredients: Ginseng is rich in vitamins and minerals that can nourish and strengthen hair strands, making them less prone to breakage and damage. The caffeine in coffee promotes blood circulation and stimulates hair growth. It also helps restore the natural shine and luster of the hair. Avocado helps to seal in moisture, and it contains biotin, a vitamin that is essential for healthy hair growth. Ingredients: Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Olea Europaea (Olive) Fruit Oil, Persea Gratissima (Avocado) Oil, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Squalane (Olive Derived), Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Helianthus Annuus Seed Oil & Panax Ginseng Root Extract & Rosmarinus Officinalis Leaf Extract, Crambe Abyssinica Seed Oil, Tocopherol (Vitamin E), Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Coffea Arabica (Coffee) Seed Oil, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Extract, Zingiber Officinale (Ginger) Root Oil. Directions: ● Use onto scalp on dry hair before shampooing ● Part hair into sections and apply product directly onto scalp ● Massage gently and leave for a minimum of 1 hour ● Cleanse with Shampoo and Conditioner Recommendations: For weak or thinning hair types.

The caffeine in coffee promotes blood circulation and stimulates hair growth. It also helps restore the natural shine and luster of the hair.
